issues.message: Quantifier always repeats zero times; it can be removed.
issues.hint: Remove the quantified element or replace it with an empty pattern.

issues.message: Suspicious \1 inside character class: this is octal (\x01), not a backreference to group 1.
issues.hint: Backreferences do not work inside character classes. If you intended to match the same text as group 1, move the check outside the class.

issues.message: Quantifier "*" is lazy under the U flag and is followed only by what may match nothing, so it always matches its minimum.
issues.hint: Remove the quantified item, make the quantifier greedy, or anchor what must follow it.

issues.message: Quantifier "?" is lazy under the U flag and ends the pattern, so it always matches its minimum.
